visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A tortoiseshell cat with green eyes sits on a light-colored wood laminate floor in a bright indoor room. The cat looks directly at the lens as text appears in the center. The background features a minimalist interior with a cream-colored wall and a glimpse of a cat scratching post in the distance. (2) The camera angle shifts slightly as the cat turns its body away from the viewer, looking toward the right. It sits in a hunched, expectant posture. The lighting is even and natural, illuminating the cat's multicolored fur texture. (3) The cat rolls onto its side and then its back, exposing its belly and paws. Its eyes are wide and dilated, looking up at an off-screen presence. The movement is fluid and playful, occurring in the center of the frame. (4) A human hand enters from the right side of the frame and approaches the cat. The cat sits back up, maintaining eye contact with the hand. The scene remains focused on the cat's facial expressions and body language. (5) The human hand begins to pet and scratch the cat's upper back and neck area. The cat leans into the touch, looking around with a satisfied but alert expression. The camera stays in a medium shot showing the interaction. (6) A series of close-up shots show the hand scratching the cat under its chin, then its back, and finally its head. The cat's eyes squint slightly in enjoyment. The background remains consistent with the indoor wooden floor. (7) The human hand stops moving, and the cat looks up at the camera again with a neutral expression before shifting its weight. (8) The video cuts to a solid pink background with white text and a brand logo centered on the screen.
